notes: Eclipse Loop 1.0.6 - New ON AIR broadcast console (View > ON AIR / Cmd-6): spectrum + EQ curve, stereo VU, LUFS with true-peak, two-person recording, a full mic voice chain (high-pass, noise gate, de-esser, compressor, RADIO FX, -1 dBFS limiter), MONITOR, auto-duck, a 12-slot sound board and webcam PIP. Recording: REC now picks its source - any hardware input, Computer Audio, or Computer + Input as one mixed take with music/voice balance, a live input meter, optional stereo pairs, and takes up to 30 minutes. Sampling: Stem x Chop crossgrid (chop the vocal, keep the beat), Sample Morph, spectral de-noise, pitch-preserving formant shift and Warp to Grid. Plus a rewritten Keyboard Shortcuts reference and a warning if an older build ever gets installed over a newer one.
